verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל־ תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî wə·’al- tiṯ·‘al·lam mit·tə·ḥin·nā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Maskil of David Listen to my prayer O God and do not ignore my plea
verses.literalPt: Dá ouvidos, ó Deus, à minha oração; e não te escondas da minha súplica.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šî·ḇāh lî wa·‘ă·nê·nî ’ā·rîḏ bə·śî·ḥî wə·’ā·hî·māh
verses.literal: Attend to me and answer me I am restless in my complaint and distraught
verses.literalPt: Atende-me a mim e responde-me. Agitado estou no meu queixar e ando perplexo,

verses.original: מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי־ יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl ’ō·w·yêḇ mip·pə·nê ‘ā·qaṯ rā·šā‘ kî- yā·mî·ṭū ‘ā·lay ’ā·wen ū·ḇə·’ap̄ yiś·ṭə·mū·nî
verses.literal: at the voice of the enemy at the pressure of the wicked For they bring down disaster upon me and resent me in their anger
verses.literalPt: por causa da voz do inimigo, em consequência da opressão do iníquo. Porque lançam sobre mim iniquidade, e, com ira, me perseguem.

verses.original: לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî yā·ḥîl bə·qir·bî wə·’ê·mō·wṯ mā·weṯ nā·p̄ə·lū ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: My heart pounds within me and the terrors of death assail me
verses.literalPt: O meu coração confrange-se dentro de mim, e terrores de morte caem sobre mim.

verses.original: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’āh wā·ra·‘aḏ yā·ḇō ḇî wat·tə·ḵas·sê·nî pal·lā·ṣūṯ
verses.literal: Fear and trembling grip me and horror has overwhelmed me
verses.literalPt: Temor e tremor são vindos sobre mim, e acabrunha-me o horror.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי־ יִתֶּן־ לִּ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar mî- yit·ten- lî ’ê·ḇer kay·yō·w·nāh ’ā·‘ū·p̄āh wə·’eš·kō·nāh
verses.literal: I said Oh that I had wings like a dove I would fly away and find rest
verses.literalPt: Disse eu: Oxalá que eu tivesse asas como pomba! Então, voaria e descansaria.

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ar·ḥîq nə·ḏōḏ ’ā·lîn bam·miḏ·bār se·lāh
verses.literal: How far away I would flee In the wilderness I would remain Selah
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu fugiria para longe; eu pousaria no deserto. (Selá)

verses.original: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥî·šāh mip̄·lāṭ lî mê·rū·aḥ sō·‘āh mis·sā·‘ar
verses.literal: I would hurry to my shelter far from this raging . . . tempest
verses.literalPt: Apressar-me-ia a um abrigo do vento tempestuoso e da procela.

verses.original: בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָי פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי־ רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: bal·la‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy pal·laḡ lə·šō·w·nām kî- rā·’î·ṯî ḥā·mās wə·rîḇ bā·‘îr
verses.literal: O Lord confuse and confound their speech for I see violence and strife in the city
verses.literalPt: Destrói, Senhor, e divide as suas línguas, porque vejo violência e contenda na cidade.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל־ חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh yə·sō·wḇ·ḇu·hā ‘al- ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·hā wə·’ā·wen wə·‘ā·māl bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: Day and night they encircle . . . the walls while malice and trouble lie within
verses.literalPt: Andam dia e noite ao redor dela, por cima dos seus muros; também iniquidade e malícia estão no meio dela.

verses.original: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ וְֽלֹא־ יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haw·wō·wṯ bə·qir·bāh wə·lō- yā·mîš mê·rə·ḥō·ḇāh tōḵ ū·mir·māh
verses.literal: Destruction is within oppression and deceit never leave the streets
verses.literalPt: Há destruição no meio dela, e das suas ruas não se apartam vexame e dolo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא־ מְ֭שַׂנְאִי עָלַ֣י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ’ō·w·yêḇ yə·ḥā·rə·p̄ê·nî wə·’eś·śā lō- mə·śan·’î ‘ā·lay hiḡ·dîl wə·’es·sā·ṯêr mim·men·nū
verses.literal: For it is not an enemy who insults me that I could endure It is not a foe who rises against me from him I could hide
verses.literalPt: Porquanto não é um inimigo que me ultraja; tê-lo-ia então suportado; nem é o que me odeia quem se exalta contra mim; ter-me-ia, então, escondido dele;

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּֽעִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ĕ·nō·wōš kə·‘er·kî ’al·lū·p̄î ū·mə·yud·dā·‘î
verses.literal: But it is you a man like myself my companion and close friend
verses.literalPt: mas és tu, homem meu igual, meu companheiro e meu amigo íntimo.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yaḥ·dāw nam·tîq sō·wḏ bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm nə·hal·lêḵ bə·rā·ḡeš
verses.literal: We shared sweet fellowship together we walked with the crowd into the house of God
verses.literalPt: A sós, nos entretínhamos em suaves práticas e, com a multidão, andávamos na Casa de Deus.

verses.original: יַשִּׁימָוֶת עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי־ רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yaš·šī·må̄·wɛṯ ʿå̄·lē·mō yê·rə·ḏū šə·’ō·wl ḥay·yîm kî- rā·‘ō·wṯ bim·ḡū·rām bə·qir·bām
verses.literal: Let death seize them by surprise . . . let them go down to Sheol alive for evil is with them in their homes
verses.literalPt: Apanhe-os, de súbito, a morte; desçam vivos a Sheol; porque há maldade na morada deles, no seu íntimo.

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eq·rā Yah·weh yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: But I call to God and the LORD saves me
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, invocarei a Deus; e Jeová me salvará.

verses.original: עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·reḇ wā·ḇō·qer wə·ṣā·ho·ra·yim ’ā·śî·ḥāh wə·’e·hĕ·meh way·yiš·ma‘ qō·w·lî
verses.literal: Morning noon and night I cry out in distress and He hears my voice
verses.literalPt: De tarde, de manhã e ao meio-dia, me queixarei e lamentarei; e ele ouvirá a minha voz.

verses.original: פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־ לִ֑י כִּֽי־ בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḏāh ḇə·šā·lō·wm nap̄·šî miq·qă·rāḇ- lî kî- ḇə·rab·bîm hā·yū ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me even though many oppose me
verses.literalPt: Ele, para paz, remiu a minha alma, a fim de que se não aproximem de mim, pois havia muitos que contendiam contra mim.

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֤ע׀ אֵ֨ל׀ וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·ma‘ ’êl wə·ya·‘ă·nêm wə·yō·šêḇ qe·ḏem se·lāh ’ă·šer ’ên ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ lā·mōw wə·lō yā·rə·’ū ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God will hear and humiliate them the One enthroned for the ages Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God
verses.literalPt: Deus ouvirá e lhes responderá (Aquele que está entronizado desde a eternidade.) (Selá) a eles, para quem não há mudanças, e que não temem a Deus.

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·laḥ yā·ḏāw biš·lō·māw ḥil·lêl bə·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: My companion attacks . . . his friends he violates his covenant
verses.literalPt: Tal homem estende as mãos sobre os que estavam em paz com ele; profanou a sua aliança.

verses.original: חָלְק֤וּ׀ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקֲרָב־ לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·lə·qū maḥ·mā·’ōṯ pîw ū·qă·rāḇ- lib·bōw rak·kū ḏə·ḇā·rāw miš·še·men wə·hêm·māh p̄ə·ṯi·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: His speech is smooth as butter but war is in his heart His words are softer than oil yet they are swords unsheathed
verses.literalPt: Macia era a sua boca como manteiga, mas o seu coração respirava guerra. As suas palavras eram mais brandas que azeite; contudo, eram elas espadas desembainhadas.

verses.original: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־ יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־ יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: haš·lêḵ ‘al- Yah·weh yə·hā·ḇə·ḵā wə·hū yə·ḵal·kə·le·ḵā lō- yit·tên lə·‘ō·w·lām mō·wṭ laṣ·ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you He will never . . . let the righteous be shaken
verses.literalPt: Lança sobre Jeová a tua carga, e ele te sustentará; jamais permitirá que o justo seja abalado.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם׀ לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא־ יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm tō·w·ri·ḏêm liḇ·’êr ša·ḥaṯ ’an·šê ḏā·mîm ū·mir·māh lō- ye·ḥĕ·ṣū yə·mê·hem wa·’ă·nî ’eḇ·ṭaḥ- bāḵ
verses.literal: But You O God will bring them down to the Pit of destruction men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days But I will trust in You
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, ó Deus, os farás descer ao poço da perdição. Homens sanguinários e fraudulentos não chegarão à metade dos seus dias. Mas, quanto a mim, eu confiarei em ti.
